title: Activity integration can be more fine-grained.
line: A vault tied to an activity now stays open for two minutes after you switch away, so a quick look at another activity no longer locks it.
explanation: The Plasma Vault service closed every vault restricted to some activities the moment the current activity changed to one it doesn't belong to. Briefly checking another activity therefore locked the vault and you had to type the password again. The service now starts a 120 s timer per open vault when you leave its activities, cancels it if you come back in time, and closes the vault when it runs out; the delay can be changed (0 = close immediately) with ActivityCloseDelay in the General group of plasmavaultrc, without new UI, as the maintainer suggested in comment 5.

commits.message:
kded: close activity-bound vaults two minutes after leaving the activity

Switching to an activity a vault doesn't belong to closed it right away,
so a quick look at another activity meant unlocking it again. Now it
only closes after 120 s away (plasmavaultrc General/ActivityCloseDelay).

BUG: 385984

media.caption: Master: switching from Default to Other closes the Work vault at once.
Fix: right after switching to Other the Work vault is still open.
Master: a 5-second visit to Other and back leaves the vault closed.
Fix: after the same 5-second visit the vault is still open.
Fix: staying in Other, the vault closes about 120 s after the switch.
